prerequisite.repackaging_note: Mail-formatted rendering generated from the locally applied public v4 commit for git-am testing. Its stable patch-id matches the public attachment and its resulting source tree is unchanged.

followups.purpose: Handle CMake include-directory results returned as either strings or arrays, and escape spaces in exported include flags.

Keep PostgreSQL headers ahead of extra_include_dirs, pass those directories to all six fallback header probes, and export paths containing spaces for PGXS and pg_config. Based on Andres Freund's CF6056 prototype and Thomas Munro's comments; general Make/shell metacharacter serialization is not claimed.

verification.native_builds: GitHub-hosted Windows x64 and ARM64 only
verification.scope: Controlled CMake/pkg-config and extra_include_dirs include-export cases, focused Meson fallback header-argument controls, and actual psql header-order canary builds. No full server, installed extension, provider, full optional-dependency configuration, or PGXS runtime claim.
